# Instagram captions – My Magic Busy Book

All images/videos must show real pages from the book. Mark book-style mockups as mockups.

## 1 – Launch
Meet Leo the Little Explorer 🦁 He has 36 little missions and he needs a helper!
My Magic Busy Book is a 48-page printable for ages 3–5: match, sort, count, build and imagine across six little worlds.
📄 Instant PDF download (US Letter + A4) · ✂️ grown-up prep · ♻️ reusable cards
Link in bio. #LittleWorldsLearning #PrintableBusyBook #PreschoolActivities

## 2 – Rainbow Rescue
Six clouds lost their colour! 🌈 Can your little one match each raindrop back to its cloud?
Every drop has a colour AND a symbol (heart, circle, star, leaf, wave, diamond) so colour isn't the only clue.
Mission 01 is our free sample – grab it from the link in bio. #ColourMatching #PreschoolAtHome

## 3 – Number Town
Count the balloons, feed the monster, fill the bakery trays 🧁 Number Town has six counting missions with cards 1–10.
Tip: touch each picture once as you count aloud together.
#CountingActivities #EarlyMaths #BusyBook

## 4 – Prep in one evening
One evening of cutting = weeks of quiet-time play ✂️
Print at Actual size, cut along the solid lines, pop each sheet's cards in an envelope. Laminating is optional!
Ten missions need no cutting at all.
#PrintAndPlay #ScreenFreePlay

## 5 – Feelings Forest
How does Leo feel today? 💛 Swap his eyes and mouth, match faces to feeling words and find kind ways to help a friend.
Faces can mean different things to different people – a lovely way to start a chat.
#SocialEmotionalLearning #FeelingsForKids #LittleWorldsLearning
